Establishes OP-207/OP-207Res only for HAL hand sheeting when FORGE or scanning devices are inoperable and points to examples on OP-207 tablet flaps.

relevant_dates_and_versions: OP-117 v2, 2025-12-15; photographed examples undated/unidentified and one contains a 2021 sample date

applicability: Driver refers to a hand sheet, manual sheet, Delivery Record, Delivery Manifest Record, or 'Blue Sheet'
FORGE or a scanning device may be inoperable
Manual delivery documentation is being considered
conditions: The exact official form identifier and revision must be confirmed
OP-117 expressly names OP-207/OP-207Res for the HAL outage branch
The photographed examples are undated/unidentified and one contains a 2021 sample date
Different delivery, pickup, hazmat, and accident forms must not be conflated
exceptions: Normal functioning FORGE/scanning follows the electronic source-established workflow rather than the manual contingency
Hazmat manifests and accident forms are separate artifact families with separate procedures

analysis_of_conflict_or_ambiguity: The record intentionally supports driver shorthand retrieval while withholding the unsupported identity and complete fill-out procedure. It must not be used to label either supplied photograph as the current Blue Sheet.
what_remains_uncertain: What exact form number/title is printed on the sheet?
What revision or date is shown?
Is this HAL, another delivery, pickup, hazmat, or accident documentation?
Is FORGE or the scanner completely inoperable?
What current station instruction accompanies the form?
decision_needed: Determine whether Ready Route can approve a complete canonical procedure for: Driver asks how to complete a hand sheet or 'Blue Sheet' when FORGE or scanning is unavailable
